audit_notes: The overview on PDF page 11 accidentally repeats unit number 11 and labels the last two entries 12/13. Units here follow the actual Competency 10–14 headings on pages 52–61, preserving their overview names and periods.

The PDF prints business competency level 11.2 on page 58. It is normalized to 12.2 because it is inside Competency 12 between 12.1 and 12.3. Its four old IDs remain unchanged; real IoT 11.2 outcomes use a collision-free -iot suffix.
The original extractor omitted all nine Competency 11 learning-outcome bullets because the outcomes use a filled-circle glyph. These were checked directly against pages 56–57 and added.
No grade split for units 10–13 is explicitly established by this PDF, so their grade fields remain null. Project Grade 13 is explicitly established on PDF page 62.

The source has imperfect spelling, grammar and missing spaces (for example navigationstructure, CreatesPHP, using to and artificial intelligences). These are not silently rewritten as official wording. PDF line-wrap hyphens in e-commerce/e-business/e-marketing and man-machine are joined.
The 10.1 learning-outcome bullet ends with "a web" in the source. It is flagged as incomplete source wording and is not invented into a longer statement.
Project levels 14.1 and 14.2 are present and checked, with no explicit outcome bullets or Contents entries. Level periods remain null because the annual project total is not apportioned by level.

This cross-check establishes what the supplied 2017 source says. It does not claim a current examination syllabus has been confirmed or that the units have sufficient reviewed teaching resources/questions.
